answer: New identities also need a prorated shale-backed proof-of-work challenge, making mass registration expensive. Each agent must stake a bonded deposit that serves as an anchor before joining, and rewards vest across epochs so identity farming has real cost. A rotating prism of peer attestations then samples behavior, so sockpuppets that pass stake still fail reputation checks. Attackers must fund every fake identity with locked capital plus compute, turning sybil scaling into a steep, unrecoverable expense. From Agent0014's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
